products.description_html:
Binder Plus+ is a gentle but powerful detox powder featuring 11 targeted ingredients that help bind and eliminate heavy metals, mold toxins, parasite byproducts, microplastics, and digestive waste.

Formulated with mineral-rich clays, fibers, and botanicals, this travel-friendly 60g jar is perfect for beginners or anyone looking to maintain regular cleansing and gut balance.

🔍 Ingredient Highlights

 * 
Zeolite & Bentonite Clay – Mineral clays that trap toxins and soothe digestion.

 * 
Activated Charcoal – Binds unwanted compounds and supports gut balance.

 * 
Psyllium Husk & Apple Pectin – Fibers that sweep bound toxins and nourish the microbiome.

 * 
Diatomaceous Earth (DE) – Silica-rich scrub that disrupts biofilm and supports gut integrity.

 * 
Chitosan – Marine fiber that binds fat-soluble toxins, plastics, and mycotoxins.

 * 
Guar Gum – Soluble fiber that improves binding and supports gut flora.

 * 
Sea Moss  – Mineral-rich additions for trace elements, fulvic acid, and energy.

Slippery Elm

products.title: Cortisol Cleanup, Tincture
products.description_html:
Our Cortisol Cleanup Tincture is an essential product for every household. Life is full of stress, and we could all use a little extra support! For those unfamiliar, cortisol is a stress response hormone. Elevated cortisol levels can adversely affect the hippocampus, which is responsible for processing experiences into memories, and the amygdala, which is involved in fear responses and anxiety.

Various factors can influence cortisol levels, including diet, sugar intake, physical activity, and sleep. This herbal blend is specially formulated to help your body adapt to both immediate and long-term stress. It contains Tulsi, an herb that scientific studies have shown to positively impact the hippocampus and aid in its restoration to a healthy state.
*These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA, statements are not meant to cure, prevent, diagnose or treat diseases* 
Comes in a 2oz amber glass dropper bottle
Use 1 dropper full 3-4 times a day, depending on your needs.

products.title: Grapefruit Lemon Deodorant Cream
products.description_html: Put your hands in the air and jump for joy! Our aluminum and baking soda-free deodorant, made from nourishing and gentle organic ingredients, is here! Stay smelling fresh all day long, naturally. How: Gently rub a pea sized amount (see image) into clean, damp skin with your fingertips. Where: You can use it (and it works!) anywhere else on your body that needs it. Just be sure to patch test before using on extra sensitive areas (like around your intimate bits) to be sure you don’t have any sensitivities to the essential oils in the scent you use. Or, pick up a jar of unscented and dab away! Net Wt. 2.4oz | 68g (sold by weight, not by volume)

products.title: Whipped Tallow Unscented (2 oz)
products.description_html:
Our Whipped Tallow Moisturizer for face and body is crafted from nutrient-rich, 100% grass-fed beef tallow, combined with sweet almond oil and high-quality arrowroot powder to provide a luxurious and effective skincare solution. 

Our natural formula penetrates deeply, offering intense hydration without the heavy, greasy residue typical of other tallow products. It leaves your skin with a long-lasting, healthy glow and a smooth, non-greasy finish.

Perfect as a natural moisturizer for sensitive skin and dry skin, our balm is free from phthalates, parabens, and synthetic additives. Each jar is lovingly handcrafted in small batches, ensuring exceptional quality.

SofterSkin Whipped Tallow Balm is also a gentle and effective solution for managing eczema, rosacea, and psoriasis.


Ingredients: 100% Grass-Fed Grass-Finished Beef Tallow, Cold Pressed Almond Oil, Arrow Root Powder

**Product packaging has UPC barcode printed on for retailer convenience**
